scope_label: absence of unintended duplicates for entities or events meant to appear once
definition: Data uniqueness is the extent to which an entity or event meant to appear once is represented without unintended duplicate records or identifiers.
explanation: The uniqueness rule depends on what is identified: customer IDs may need to be distinct even though different customers can share a name.
Uniqueness checks require a stated entity and comparison rule; repeated values are not automatically errors.
